semiconductor_relevance: High — MultiFields Technology specializes in ultra-precision motion control technologies that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing and testing.
summary: MultiFields Technology develops and promotes piezoelectric ultra-precision motion control technologies and products, focusing on applications in semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include advanced physical property characterization systems and nanometer-level automation solutions, which are essential for precision in semiconductor processes.
capabilities: Physical property characterization systems for electrical, thermal, optical, and magnetic measurements

regional_presence.China: MultiFields Technology is based in Beijing and operates as a national high-tech enterprise.
